seo.title: Case Study: DailyNotes — Productivity Mobile App | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I built DailyNotes, a simple and customizable notes app to organize your day, set goals, and track routines, available on Google Play.

hero.title: DailyNotes — organizing your day
hero.subtitle: Personal project: a simple, customizable, and efficient notes app designed to boost daily productivity without the complexity of other apps in the space.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: Most productivity apps end up being too complex for everyday use, with extra features that end up complicating something as simple as jotting down an idea or organizing your day. The goal was to build something minimal, fast, and genuinely useful.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I built a simple, customizable, and efficient notes app to organize your day, set goals, and track routines without wasting time, with folders to sort content and weekly tracking to support daily management.
incluye: Published and available on Google Play

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: DailyNotes is publicly available on Google Play, offering a simple and customizable alternative to more complex productivity apps, focused on letting users organize their day with no friction.
